verdict.rationale: Filee is documented only as a desktop file converter for Windows, Linux and macOS (preview), shipped as an installer or portable ZIP. There is no evidence of a browser-based conversion mode that needs nothing installed. Dragging files out of a browser into the app, and phrases like "nothing to install" (which refer to optional engines), are adjacent features and earn no credit; since file converters commonly offer web versions, the axis applies and the verdict is none rather than na.
